_comment: Machine-checkable END STATE for a ZED true test run. Evaluated by scripts/Test-RunRequirements.ps1 against the target repo's release.json + state.json + test-run-capture.json. Human companion: requirements/requirements.md. Do NOT weaken these to make a run pass — fix ZED instead.
_scope: ZED is service-agnostic; bdp3/MAB is only the CURRENT test target. The GENERIC checks here (step statuses, the trigger-and-cancel capture contract, parameterSyntax, noUnresolvedTokens, SafeFly shape) apply to ANY service. The SPECIFIC values (referenceRuns build ids, PROT-SFMC/SFRP pipeline keys, isc-01/ne5s-01 forbidden stamps, region lists) are bdp3/MAB-specific and live in the seed configs + reference-runs.json — a different service supplies its own via service-config.json + pipeline-catalog.json. ZED-side fixes must stay generic (no hard-coded service names/ids/stamps/regions).

referenceRuns._comment: GOLDEN successful runs. ZedForge keeps these as the reference for parameter SYNTAX. The full captured parameters are cached in requirements/reference-runs.json (refresh via scripts/Get-ReferenceRun.ps1). Compare a current run's parameter SYNTAX/FORMAT against these — NOT the literal values, which change every release (CCOA exclusions, dev-status, region set, release branch).

safefly.note: A successful R2D. At verify time, fetch this and compare the current run's R2D fields (deploymentNature, sdpType, targetedRegions, blastRadius, rollback, impactType, sev2Alerting, payloadGoingToFairfax/Mooncake, preProdTesting) for the same SHAPE.

parameterSyntax._comment: Golden syntax extracted from the reference runs. Test-RunRequirements.ps1 checks each captured pipeline parameter against the matching rule. Enforces FORMAT, not literal values.

rules.description: Stamp-list params must be a PowerShell string-array literal like @("isc-01","ne5s-01"), or * (all), or @() (none). Double-quoted short names, comma-separated, no spaces, no * inside the array. e.g. reference PublicExcludestamps=@("isc-01","ne5s-01"); Canarystamps=@("ea-01").
Region params must be regions(a,b,c) form (or regions() empty, or regions(*) for non-active clouds). e.g. reference CanaryRegions=regions(eastasia); FFRegions=regions(usgovarizona).
PubRegions must be an EXPLICIT non-empty region list — never regions(*) or *. The reference runs enumerate ~26-43 public regions inside regions(...).
ValidateOnlyRollOut must be true/false. false for a real trigger (as in every reference run).
SdpType is Standard or Conservative (reference = Standard).

forbiddenExcludeStamps.reason: isc-01/ne5s-01 were excluded in the reference runs ONLY because they were in development. They are being onboarded to SFMC: remove them from SFMC *Excludestamps AND add their regions (isc-01->indiasouthcentral, ne5s-01->northeastus5) to SFMC PubRegions. They may legitimately remain excluded in the SFRP type — owner should scope this rule to SFMC if so.

caveats: Compare SYNTAX/FORMAT, not literal stamp/region values — those change every release.
CCOA-excluded stamps (e.g. we-01..we-14 in build 159830918) are time-dependent; do not expect the same CCOA stamps in the current run.

isc-01/ne5s-01 are being onboarded to SFMC: remove from SFMC *Excludestamps AND add their regions (indiasouthcentral, northeastus5) to SFMC PubRegions. They may remain excluded in SFRP (the type they do not belong to).
Production params are per-pipeline-type (SFRP != SFMC, PROT != DT): compare a pipeline's params against the reference run of the SAME pipeline type; never copy across types.
ArtifactsBranch in a true test run is the ephemeral test branch (zedforge/test-...), not releases/prot<YYMM> — do not require the releases/ prefix.

safeflyReference.note: Verifier checks a R2D was filed. The agent compares these fields' SHAPE against the reference R2D during Phase 6 (fetch via referenceRuns.safefly.detailsEndpoint).
